title: Native Canvas, Camera, Registration & Interaction Surface
selection_reason: AAI-10 completed_verified after the owner-directed recovery repaired proof identity and fail-closed coverage, passed the single exact-head AAI-10 profile on Linux and Windows plus deterministic comparison, merged application PR #339, and reconciled the cross-repository closeout. ISE-01 is the previously owner-approved strict successor.
objective: Deliver the accelerated native Scene canvas with mouse, touch and pen camera controls; selection and interaction; keyboard-accessible equivalents; GM/player view modes; and assisted but user-correctable image registration, while keeping camera state presentation-only and preserving canonical Scene and owner-domain meaning.
governed_start_requirements: Receive a future owner execution command; selection alone does not authorize implementation.
Re-read the current ISE program, backlog, this checkpoint and completed MAI/AAI/Scene boundaries.
Resolve a bounded ISE-01 implementation and validation contract without inventing universal camera, grid, Scene or gameplay rules.
Create and register one dedicated implementation branch before source mutation.
Establish the appropriate ISE current-family validation surface without rerunning retired historical profiles.
preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..10 and MAI-01..10 remain completed_verified with no further implementation authority.
Existing Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle and permission authorities remain canonical.
Camera and visual canvas state are presentation state and cannot redefine canonical Scene meaning.
Generated grid/geometry assistance remains user-correctable and cannot silently become authoritative where certainty is insufficient.
Hidden and GM-only state must be permission-filtered before projection.
Missing map/audio assets remain nonblocking; placeholders, silence and theater-of-the-mind remain valid.
No third-party media redistribution, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
next_action: Selected_not_started. Wait for a future owner execution command; then perform a governed ISE-01 start transition before creating a branch or implementing product code.
